description:
Adds a calibratable compass

This mod adds a calibratable compass.

How to use it:

1. Craft the compass by putting 4 steel ingots around 1 mese crystal fragment. The new compass points to the origin / zero point and is already usable.
2. Punch the compass to a compatible node (all by default) and enter the target name
3. Now this compass always leads you to this location. You can give it away to allow other users to find this place.
4. Punch a teleport-compatible node (by default, a mese block) to teleport back to the calibrated place
